rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for making or producing a practical thing, including creating a result from materials or ingredients.

example.english: I used leftover rice to create fried rice.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 di1 sing6 faan6 zing2 zo2 caau2 faan6

rows.note: Use this for bringing something genuinely new into existence or creating an original design, especially in more formal or abstract contexts.

example.english: New technologies create more possibilities for humanity.
example.traditional: 新科技為人類創造更多可能。
example.jyutping: san1 fo1 gei6 wai4 jan4 leoi6 cong3 zou6 gang3 do1 ho2 nang4

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when an action or event causes a situation or consequence, especially an undesirable one.

example.english: Doing that will create a mess in the whole house.
example.traditional: 你咁樣搞到成間屋都亂晒。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng2 gaau2 dou3 seng4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 lyun6 saai3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that an event or behavior has brought about a resulting problem, shortage, or other condition.

example.english: This rainstorm will create flooding in many parts of the city.
example.traditional: 呢場暴雨會造成市區多處水浸。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 bou6 jyu5 wui5 zou6 sing4 si5 keoi1 do1 cyu3 seoi2 zam3
